'''Stinger fish''' were aquatic creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. They were [[Jellyfish/Legends|jellyfish]]-like creatures with suction cups that stung upon contact. The sting was not life-threatening, but was irritating and annoying. A large number of stinger fish in one place could cause confusion and panic.<ref name="BGS" />

[[Karak's renegades]] released a large number of stinger fish into the [[Fitsay]] marketplace as part of their [[Raid on Fitsay|raid]] on the [[City/Legends|city]] in an effort to secure [[Golden Sun coral|coral]] from the [[Golden Sun]].<ref name="BGS" />
